values.content:
=You are a news categorization and summarization assistant. Analyze the following news articles and return a JSON response.

For each article:
1. Assign it to ONE category from this list: "AI & Machine Learning", "Cloud & Infrastructure", "Cybersecurity", "Startups & Funding", "Software Development", "Hardware & Devices", "Business & Strategy", "Other"
2. Generate a concise 1-sentence summary (max 100 chars)
3. Assign an importance score from 1-10 (10 = most important/impactful)

Articles to analyze:
{{ JSON.stringify($json.articles.map((a, i) => ({ id: i, title: a.title, description: a.description.substring(0, 300) }))) }}

Respond ONLY with valid JSON in this exact format:
{
  "categorized": [
    { "id": 0, "category": "AI & Machine Learning", "summary": "Brief summary here", "importance": 8 },
    ...
  ]
}
